info.title: Yantiq Application API — DESIGN
info.description: Proposed contract, not implemented. Decision ledger and integration rules are normative companions. All /api routes require Firebase authentication; admin routes additionally require server-held administrator role.

servers.description: Replace with approved private HTTPS origin; not a live host.

get.description: Database availability gates backend readiness; optional AI availability is separately reported operationally.
Verify token; upsert guardian by Firebase UID atomically if missing. No child data in Firebase.

delete.description: Hide immediately; schedule live purge seven days later. Repeated deletion by owner within recovery window is 204.

post.description: Owner only before purge_after. Expired recovery window returns 409 if row still exists, otherwise 404.

get.description: Full currently active catalog with metadata only. Authenticated; 304 when unchanged. Initial small curriculum uses full snapshots.

ETag.description: Quoted revision/version token. Supply exactly in If-Match for admin updates.

get.description: Authenticated published reference media, never child recordings. Initial version does not require Range support.

get.description: Daily activity defaults to last 30 UTC days; aggregate counts, not historical scores.

post.description: Backend derives expected_text/type/language/threshold from pinned revision. No current result persisted unless best. Duplicate completed key returns 409 ALREADY_PROCESSED, never repeats scoring. See contracts/shared/integration-rules.md.
